title: Better Peaceful
description: Removes hostile mobs, except for mobs, which you need to beat the ender dragon.
body:
# Better Peaceful

[![Download on Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/Download-Modrinth-1bd96a?style=for-the-badge\&logo=modrinth\&logoColor=white)](https://modrinth.com/datapack/better-peaceful)
[![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Join-Discord-5865F2?style=for-the-badge\&logo=discord\&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/xS85W48Cb3)

## Overview

This datapack brings the feeling of **Peaceful Mode** without removing the possibility of **completing the game**.

Most hostile mobs are prevented from spawning, creating a **calmer survival experience** while still allowing players to progress through **all major milestones**, including **defeating the Ender Dragon**.

**Better Peaceful** is perfect for players who enjoy **building**, **exploring**, and **surviving** without constantly fighting hostile creatures.

## Features

* Removes **most hostile mobs** from the game.
* Keeps **important progression mobs** alive.
* Allows players to access **Blaze Rods** and **Ender Pearls**.
* Supports **defeating the Ender Dragon**.
* Fully configurable **mob blacklist**.
* **Multiplayer-friendly**.
* **Lightweight** and easy to install.

## Whitelisted Hostile Mobs

The following hostile mobs are **not removed**:

```txt
minecraft:blaze
minecraft:enderman
minecraft:ender_dragon
minecraft:wither
minecraft:warden
```

## Customizing the Mob Blacklist

To remove or add mobs to the **blacklist**, open:

```txt
Better-Peaceful-1-0-0.zip\data\betterpeaceful\tags\entity_type\banned.json
```

You can then:

* Add mob IDs to **blacklist** them.
* Remove mob IDs to **allow them to spawn**.

## ⚠️ Important

This datapack is **not designed for worlds with the difficulty set to Peaceful**.

Instead, it should be used on **Easy**, **Normal**, or **Hard** difficulty. The datapack only removes hostile mobs that are **not necessary for completing the game**.

## Installation

1. **Download** the datapack.
2. Move the `.zip` file into your world's `datapacks` folder.
3. Run `/reload` or **restart the world/server**.
4. Enjoy a **more relaxed Minecraft experience**.

## Compatibility

* Singleplayer ✔
* Multiplayer ✔
* Vanilla ✔
* Most datapacks ✔

## Have Fun!

Thank you for downloading **Better Peaceful**. I hope you enjoy a **calmer Minecraft adventure** while still being able to experience **the ender fight**.
